title: Codewars 8kyu: String Repeat
description: Write a function that accepts an integer `repeat` and a string `string`, and returns the string repeated exactly that many times.
constraints:
0 <= repeat <= 1000
• Time: O(N * repeat) | Space: O(N * repeat)
starter_code:
def repeat_str(repeat: int, string: str) -> str:
    pass
solution:
def repeat_str(repeat: int, string: str) -> str:
    return string * repeat
explanation: Python string repetition operator executes in O(N * repeat) time.
